description.it: Titoli e copie per genere (narrativa) e classe (saggistica), con i prestiti del periodo.
description.en: Titles and copies by genre (fiction) and class (non-fiction), with the loans of the period.

sql: WITH c AS (SELECT b.id AS biblio_id, b.kind AS kind, CASE WHEN b.kind = 'fiction' THEN b.genre_code ELSE b.class_code END AS code FROM biblio b), held AS (SELECT c.kind AS kind, c.code AS code, COUNT(DISTINCT c.biblio_id) AS titles, COUNT(i.id) AS copies FROM c JOIN item i ON i.biblio_id = c.biblio_id AND i.status <> 'withdrawn' GROUP BY 1, 2), lent AS (SELECT c.code AS code, COUNT(*) AS loans FROM loan l JOIN item i ON i.id = l.item_id JOIN c ON c.biblio_id = i.biblio_id WHERE date(l.issued_at) BETWEEN :from AND :to GROUP BY 1) SELECT held.code AS classification, held.titles AS titles, held.copies AS copies, COALESCE(lent.loans, 0) AS loans FROM held LEFT JOIN lent ON lent.code IS held.code ORDER BY held.kind, held.code
